mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and sodium depletion can exacerbate electrolyte imbalances, and mesalamine may impair renal function, potentially reducing torsemide efficacy and increasing diuretic-related complications.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium), renal function, and blood pressure regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent if needed.
